text: A valid user can log in and reaches the product list
Invalid, empty or locked-out credentials are rejected with a clear, non-revealing message
Protected pages require a session; logout ends it
Each product shows its own name, price and image
Products can be sorted by name and by price in both directions
A product detail page shows the product that was selected
Products can be added to and removed from the cart; the badge reflects the cart
Checkout step one validates first name, last name and postal code, and cannot start with an empty cart
The overview shows correct item total, tax and grand total
A completed order shows a confirmation and clears the cart
Cart state is kept across navigation; Cancel and Reset behave as labelled
Login completes within 2 seconds (assumed target; no SLA is published)
Prices and layout are identical for every user profile
